result.classification: The bottleneck stayed with physical validator-4 host 203.0.113.16 after it was assigned validator-3 identity 0x03. This points at physical VPS/substrate/runtime behavior, not validator identity 0x04 or data shard routing.

success_criteria.diagnostic_classification: bad performance either stays with physical host 203.0.113.16 or follows validator identity 0x04 to 203.0.113.14

interpretation.bad_stays_on_validator_4_physical_endpoi: physical VPS host/substrate is causal; move benchmark control to fresh host or remove this host from green topology
interpretation.bad_moves_to_validator_3_physical_endpoi: validator identity/data-shard path is causal; inspect owner assignment, key/id-specific routing, and validator-id sharding
interpretation.both_recover: role placement interaction was causal; rerun to confirm before changing topology
interpretation.both_bad: cluster-wide substrate or loadgen control is unstable; repro on fresh Ansible baseline
